answer.summary: App fails at startup, not in a test: Flyway rejects two migrations with the same version V6_20261121140000000 (Coverage_scenario_safe_mode_and_approval and, per the touched files, Add_finding_lifecycle). The duplicate is in the change itself, so re-running on the same commit will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate Flyway migration version found: V6_20261121140000000__Coverage_scenario_safe_mode_and_approval.class
